about: Pre-rendered narrator clips (Kokoro-82M, Apache-2.0, via kokoro-js). Made by tools/voice-gen.js (npm run voices); do not edit.

0042c57f2f4b5971.t: The closer your plate, the bigger the tip. The best one gets a bonus. Most tips wins!

005f1774a368ec61.t: The spectrum. A spectrum goes up on the big screen, like Morning person ↔ Night owl . No wrong answers!

01271e097aea1056.t: Good evening, agents. I am Director Grey. We have a problem: a mole has slipped into the agency.

019df9282486e172.t: At first light, the summoning circles awaken.

028b1c04d1acd8d6.t: Find your spot. Place yourself where YOU stand. Nobody sees it until the reveal.. Drag the marker (or tap ◀ ▶), then tap Lock it in .

02ada1fc4304aec3.t: Listen to your head chef and scoop it up!

02b7a178bd9a1ea4.t: Last scoop of the night! Make it magical!

0505f52c17d548ef.t: Thank goodness you came. I am Detective Hazel Finch. My old friend Elias Vane, the clockmaker, has vanished, and his study was locked from the inside. His Golden Gear is gone too. Each of you is holding a different piece of the evidence. Talk to each other, open every lock, and tell me who did it.

053113ed56473988.t: Let me see the agents on this case.

064c6f3cc76348ba.t: Let me see my new partners.

0676448a18cea75b.t: All aboard the Midnight Express. The Magpie’s crew struck again: the Duchess’s blue diamond was swapped for glass somewhere in Car Seven. The train reaches the border at dawn. Search the carriage, open every lock, and find the swapper before we arrive.

06e4162e074df603.t: Howdy, folks, and welcome to JustBid! I'm Rusty Rattlebang, fastest gavel in the West!

0814efe43b3c00c9.t: Contestants, tell me something funny about yourselves!

0850a49eff769551.t: All In. The final question: see the category, bet any share of your points, then answer.. Tap how much to bet (up to ALL IN), then your answer.

08e9f534d75069b0.t: Let's find out where you stand!

0ac8913913e5f6e5.t: The spotlight. Answers go into the spotlight one at a time. Guess who wrote each one.. Tap the name of who you think said it.

0b19765dd30c0905.t: Time is up! I picked the last lock myself. We found the culprit, but the Magpie’s trail went cold for a while.

0b27f4d9cf587d63.t: Gull Point lighthouse. The storm is rolling in, and the Magpie is somewhere inside with everything they ever stole. This is the hardest lock of my career, and I cannot open it alone. Light the lamp, open the vault, and unmask the Magpie at last.

0baff8183fc8c949.t: Eyes on the order. Remember everything!

0c77e487e4552ee6.t: Draw one line. See where everyone is dropping, then draw ONE line to steer balls: yours to the jackpot, a rival’s into a bust.. Draw with your finger (2 strokes max), then tap Done!

0d939e54866eb801.t: Check your phones. The first case file is open.

0dea49158f5e33f0.t: Uh oh. That sundae melted all over the floor.

0dec9c171e5b1eac.t: One of you has the ticket. Read it out loud, and do not show your phone!

0e090e4b4c98be5e.t: Agents score for catching moles. Moles score for slipping by. Most points at the end of the night wins.

0f366055539c4aa1.t: Winning. Each round the board gets harder, and old lines stay as ghosts. Most money wins!

0fc7cd004df75bd3.t: The truck phone is ringing! Listen!

0fcc924f6a002a72.t: Interrogate. Grill the suspect out loud. Ask questions, watch them sweat. Then everyone votes for the lie.. Tap the statement you think is the lie.

0ff868e6ea4e1527.t: Tonight’s callers are on the line!

1252505ce960aba4.t: Here's everyone on the scale tonight!

12f437289df11d3d.t: Look! Shell, filling, salsa, and what goes on each taco.

134049ee74ed3675.t: A customer shows me the burger they want. Look sharp, folks, it is gone in a few seconds!

134b91512b12140b.t: The Golden Gear is back where it belongs, and Elias was hiding safe in the clock tower all along. But the Magpie is still out there. Case closed, for tonight.

13a80965235ae992.t: Twists. Swap Sides: mid-debate, argue the opposite! Lawyer Mode: defend an object accused of a crime. Hot Takes: 20 seconds each. Team Debates in big rooms.

15150f82a79ab6d2.t: Biddin’ is OPEN! Who’ll start me off?

1777235106adaf32.t: And a hearty howdy to everyone else!

17d91295b924801b.t: Take your time. I'll just stand here… looking fabulous.

18cbf132a1b9f7e7.t: Ten seconds! Send me what you have!

196cdd6cf949be0e.t: Oh no. That customer will not come back.

1a1a5a335251b6ed.t: Half the time is gone. Keep going!

1a999382807b8b41.t: Tap serve when it is ready. When the clock runs out, whatever you made goes out.

1b2da88d1001f5eb.t: The closer your roll, the bigger the tip. The best one earns a bonus. Most tips wins.

1bed02e8945f4c14.t: We close the shop. Grazie, my cooks, you did beautifully!

1beda3a4f3b64482.t: Feast your eyes on this beauty!

1c3fee585185c674.t: Unpacking. The winner’s locker is unpacked item by item, from Junk to LEGENDARY. Profit or loss?

1ced3b4079ab7551.t: The Magpie is caught at last, the treasures go home, and Elias wants to build you all a clock. Case closed. You are the finest detectives I have ever worked with.

1cf0c2c702d6afcc.t: Bonuses. Within 5% without going over: Bullseye, +500. The exact price: Jackpot, +1000! Three close rounds in a row: Hot Streak, +300.

1d7489177c3a108f.t: The knives are clean. Thank you, my cooks. Well rolled.

1e209606d1c8542f.t: The crowd decides. Vote for the winner, then pick the best line. Debaters score their vote share (up to 1000) +200 for the win, up to +300 crowd meter, +250 best line. Back the winner: +100.. Tap a side, then tap the speech with the best line.

1f0b78b19352ae8a.t: Look, look! Crust, sauce, cheese, toppings.

1fb4199574f7ecd3.t: A phone order. Listen with your whole heart.

2112d1555552050a.t: Scoring. The room shares one team score. You earn +150 for each module you solve, +100 for holding the right page, and +200 for every bomb your squad defuses.

213b929d9b8413ae.t: The gallery is open. Vote for your favourite, but not your own!

220e2c450747d872.t: Plot twists. Silent movie · Sound effects only · Act it as… a style · Freeze frame (one pose per buzz) · Relay · Two-person scene (two prompts, guess both).

2218f605095d519d.t: One last chance, mole. Name the password.

229aabf5a770857b.t: Speed round! Quick clues, no hesitating.

22b00c5746d3176e.t: We are pulling into the station! I cracked the last lock just in time, but the Magpie’s crew got a head start.

22fe7addd0131ca3.t: Two debaters, one silly topic. Each debate, two players step up to the podiums with a topic and a side: Is cereal a soup? You say YES. Everyone else is the audience.. Debaters: your side shows in big letters.

246c7b80fa22fcea.t: Grill is off, lights are low. Great flipping tonight, cooks!

24f76c30d50e5af5.t: Last plate before the truck closes. Make it shine!

25111d96e5672b87.t: Your photos go up on the wall with numbers, and no names. Vote for your favourite, but never your own. Or guess what each one is.

27babcc889feb739.t: Evening, high rollers! You all play against me at once. Beat my hand, and the most chips at the end wins.

27ea371655f2549e.t: Let's play JustBid! Bidding is OPEN!

28301493b3024618.t: Check every photo. If one is not the real thing, flag it!

28e29e9fd4d50057.t: Predict. Then guess who the ROOM will pick. +100 if your vote matches the winner, +150 for a correct prediction.. Tap who you think will win (or Skip prediction).

2adc3b7e82f6b43d.t: Each scene, one actor gets a secret prompt on their phone, and acts it out for the room.

2bcd8f55a5ee45c8.t: The sweet spot. Your song: if some, but not all, got it, you score 150 times the difficulty. If everyone got it, just 50 times. If nobody did, zero. Pick fun-hard, not impossible!

2c95b3536c97ed97.t: Look at your phones. Each of you is holding something different: a journal, a photograph, a map, or the controls of a lock.

2cae49cef68df0bc.t: Aprons on! Here comes the first customer.

2cccc8f0c2c8a92d.t: Welcome to Hot Take Trivia! I’m Blaze Bixby. Know it? Then bet on it!

2ccef3c5d341f9bd.t: Heat wave! Everybody wants ice cream right now!

2d4c69d9ca583b82.t: The story remembers. What you do early on comes back later. Something from day one can save you on the last night.. Your badges show what the story remembers about you.

2d5f15c277e5df35.t: Hear ye, hear ye! The royal court of President is now in session!

2e6f6fed2489221f.t: Close enough! They are still munching.

305ced8083f934cb.t: Bravo! After every scene, applaud the best performance: each clap is worth 25 points to the actor. The awards night crowns the Oscar-worthy and the Mime Master! Tap the clap on the actor you loved.

319f063d346c3a71.t: Final case of the night. Make it count.

31b3b973e806b972.t: Talk it over. Who sounds like they are bluffing?

31c6e0aa2c528578.t: Hola, cooks! I am Tía Lupe. My taco truck is the fastest in the food court, and tonight it is yours!

31f0b8fab714c69e.t: Our first guest. Watch carefully. Every piece matters.

31ffccff7964d5e9.t: Shout it out. Shouting works too: the actor taps They got it! and picks who said it first.. Actor: tap They got it! then tap the guesser’s name.

3209a0e590c884ca.t: Phones out! Let's play Emoji Charades!

3232bcfba041de20.t: Phones out, partners! Type it in!

33fddd41367fbb8d.t: Pick your spot, draw your line, and let it DROP!

344d6ff6c996818a.t: Colour match! Find me that exact colour, and fill the frame.

350f721a01a8fb91.t: The title. The winner is crowned with a new TITLE: fame, not points. Ties share the crown!

37daef6a2cb4a559.t: One letter. One list. Every answer has to start with it.

38a3d79bb95bfe02.t: And a big hand for everyone else!

38a78bdf364bd0a3.t: Wrong agent. The mole is still among us.

3a591858d9ef1c73.t: The hot seat. One by one, each suspect’s three statements go up on the big screen, shuffled.

3a8f2ff586591dc3.t: Fix the ship. Trust no one. And whatever you do, don’t get abducted.

3b271e0cc4468d8e.t: Chicken Run. Count the chickens crossing Main Street. Ducks, turkeys and rabbits don’t count! Tap plus one for every chicken, fix it with minus one, then lock in.

3d10a6517e5003bb.t: Vote. Vote for the player who fits it best. Votes are secret!. Tap a player’s name to vote.

3e1fb88f4df73a38.t: Oh no, brain freeze! What is that?

3f47c9fa75d71733.t: Quick look! Faster than a hot tortilla!

3fe1ac6ab6a16c5f.t: Whoa! That is not a burger, that is a sandwich mystery!

40cde78aa0d0ef0c.t: I have seen things tonight. Wonderful things.

40d9f77c9e88146e.t: Special rounds. Watch for Blink (1 second!), Two-Tone, Name It, Halfway There and Odd One Out.. Odd One Out: tap the tile that looks different, fast!

41a821f4ed435902.t: Poker face. When it’s your answer, don’t give yourself away! You get +50 for everyone you fool.

41fcc359dc8c348c.t: Hints & winning. Stuck? Hints show the words, then the first letters. The last round counts DOUBLE. Most points wins!

4212cf3f82a80aa4.t: Prep with argument cards. 30 seconds to plan. Your phone deals 3 argument cards (Made-Up Statistic, Dramatic Pause…). Tap one during your speech and it pops up on the TV.. Tap I’m ready , then tap a card mid-speech.

42157f2c6f997712.t: Pretty sweet! A little melty, but nice.

42283978feacdb44.t: Twists & finale. Some hands get a twist: Happy Hour, Five-Card Charlie, Ties Win or Lucky 21. The last hand pays DOUBLE. Broke? Free comeback chips!

424d11f95d371756.t: A customer shows you what they want. Then you build it on your phone, from memory.

4324f31ea7c26d79.t: Scoring. Right: 100 × your bet, plus up to 50 for speed. Wrong: lose 50 × your bet. Three right in a row: streak bonus!

4462637fe4444754.t: The prompt. A prompt goes up: Who’s most likely to… survive a zombie apocalypse? Think about everyone in the room.

449c7c7fff553007.t: Ooh, look at this, folks! Lock in your guesses!

449e4fb6217c5648.t: A locker rolls in with the door half up. Three peeks inside, partner, but them clues can lie!

44fc3b4ca8d3365b.t: Phones out. Let’s turn up the heat!

4614aad721e4c66c.t: The speeches. Opening statements (45 s each), rebuttals, one question from the audience, then a typed closing line you read out loud. Done early? Pass the mic.. Speaking? Tap I’m done to pass the mic.

461dc5258540567b.t: Card values. Face cards are 10, Aces are 1 or 11. Blackjack (an Ace and a 10-card) pays 3 to 2. The dealer draws to 17.

464e4bd6ebcb473b.t: Pass it on. Roll it through a gap at the edge (the little yellow arrows) and it lands on your neighbour’s phone.. Yellow arrows at the edge of your board are gaps to your neighbours.

470b3f6e77a80c45.t: Scoring. Right guess: +100, and +50 more if you were one of the fastest. Three right in a row: +50.

470cc6ff004a1438.t: Two items enter. Which one costs more?

479446baf0d685f1.t: Guess it. Everyone else types guesses on their phone. Typos, plurals and synonyms count, and a flame means you’re close! Guesses stay blurred on the TV until one is right. Type a guess and tap Guess, as often as you like.

4796ca3d2bd701f3.t: Bet on it. How sure are you? Bet once for a hunch, double if you’re sure, or triple for a hot take. Pick your bet, then tap your answer.

479ff2c2d0e7f141.t: Blink and that burger is gone!

47d4bf45bd3a83c8.t: Alliteration. Two or more words starting with the letter score 2, like Big Blue Banana. Five scoring answers in a row: +1.

494dd23dd32b21fb.t: Which one makes the cover? You decide.

4a2e1dbf06fc20fc.t: Then run! Take the photo with your phone, check it, and send it to me. Only this room sees it.

4a7a507d7aa2f34c.t: Sweet perfection! Look at that smile!

4ab0243cf740d925.t: Pencils ready… let’s play Letter Rush!

4b3d54ca5de4323a.t: One of you has the ticket! Read it out, but no peeking!

4b52919f661cfe23.t: Only a few made it to the safehouse.

4b8ff8670695af3e.t: Nobody can open a lock alone. Read your evidence out loud, and listen to each other. That is how detectives work.

4c8eda4fc0d29085.t: Our first case. Somebody in this room is not who they say they are.

4d04076806a1bb7e.t: Most points wins. And at the end, we open the files on the best lies of the night.

4d78eb76ed3370df.t: Benvenuti to the YesChef food court! I am Nonna Pina, and tonight my pizzeria needs you!

4e869a181696c029.t: Another file on my desk. Peek at your card, quietly.

4fee92a709ad3d51.t: Howdy, partners! Welcome to Quick Draw, where the fastest thumb in the West takes it all!

50193db351ec2c2d.t: One of you has the ticket. Holler it out, but keep that phone hidden!

508f8241e4cecf71.t: That is all for tonight, agents. The agency thanks you.

50c0f9031220d026.t: Rate and react. While it plays, rate how funny it is, and spam reactions. They float up the TV and fill the laugh meter. Tap a face to rate, and tap reactions as much as you like.

512e88a90e203939.t: Good evening, and welcome to Price Panic! I'm your host, Sterling Sparks!

53cfffd7d4cd5bcd.t: Contestants, tell me somethin' funny about yourselves!

54fdff55cab54b20.t: The Clue Giver. Each round a Clue Giver secretly picks a movie, animal, food, place or saying from three choices.. Clue Giver? Tap one of the three answers.

5612ccbeeeec1b82.t: Two teams, two passwords. Find your partners.

56366dcce9d97777.t: Toppings go on slices, tacos or pieces. Burgers and sundaes are stacked, and the order matters.

566cc35e77150ad8.t: Disposal unit, we have a call-out. A crate of very silly bombs just turned up at the town fair.

572457c18876f509.t: Every round is different. Hunts, races, mystery close-ups, colours, selfies, tiny giants, captions, spot the change, the alphabet, and team shoots.

574420dd36cfd7e7.t: Copycat. Listen to the drum on the TV, then tap the same rhythm back. Two rhythms, each one longer.. Tap the pad in time when it says YOUR TURN.

57eb2138b0186e3a.t: That one is going on the cover!

584ebafc9a7723fc.t: Ghosts & the beam. Ejected players become ghosts: they patch systems (2 patches = +1 bar) and whisper suspects to the TV. A lone alien gets one abduction beam!. Ghosts: tap a system to patch, then a name to whisper.

587e29c5e4b6fee3.t: Sets & loans. Collect 3 items from the same set for a bonus. Broke? Take a bank loan (2 max), repaid with 20% interest.. Tap My collection to see your sets, or Loan for cash.

58e7841d81fdf6ea.t: The prompt. A prompt card with a blank goes up on the big screen. Fill it in with the funniest card in your hand!

59222b5222d49d86.t: Oh dear. That customer is going to the burger joint.

5a0f90dd8b19f8da.t: Tap the ingredients to stack them, bottom to top. The order matters, partner!

5a613364afad13ae.t: Stuck?. Tap an idea for inspiration, or swap your template once a round.. Tap New template to swap.

5ad5037b4ac037ae.t: How to win. Crew: make the clean jumps home (4 on a Standard trip, 2 spare shifts) or catch every alien. Aliens: break a system, match the crew’s numbers, or run out the fuel.

5ae8089e58f1869b.t: Guess the price. A product goes up on the big screen. How much does it cost?. Slide or tap to set your guess (or ⌨ Type an exact price), then tap Lock in.

5b11be5efc0ca248.t: Don't be shy! Every fact's a bargain!

5b1a1c1c165f43ce.t: A single glimpse. Like a falling leaf.

5bbeae090a992a21.t: Now build it! Bottom bun up!

5bc763fb18e137b2.t: Drag to roll. The marble starts on one phone. Whoever has it holds a finger on their board and drags the way it should roll.. When the marble is on your phone, hold a finger on the board and drag. Drag further to roll faster.

5c58c79d0b477bee.t: Not bad! They will still leave a tip.

5dd60476ef6094d2.t: Bonjour, colour lovers! I am Hugo Hue. I show you a colour, you remember it, you mix it. Simple? Ha! We shall see.

5eea95d2c1c7446b.t: One of you holds the ticket. Speak clearly. Do not show it.

5ef243dbb4697f5e.t: Fire up the grill! Go, go, go!

5f2a0823e84e4a7f.t: Ooh, who is scooping with me tonight?

5f4b4bb992961ea5.t: Bring your songs. Everyone adds songs from their phone. Search for anything, or paste a Spotify link.. Search, tap a song, done.

5fa1ea57cbde86f1.t: Now, what are we looking at? Make your guesses!

600c41abcc633f73.t: Scoring. Vote for the funniest entry: 100 points a vote. If a book’s last guess still matches the prompt, everyone on it gets +50!. Tap the funniest entry to vote.

6085c991e0b4ce7f.t: A mole has slipped into the agency. Read your card, and trust no one.

61a1a7e124c1f5e3.t: LEGENDARY! Would you look at that!

6369de1071e21a04.t: Guess it. Everyone else races to type the answer. Guess as often as you like: small typos are fine!. Type your guess and tap Send .

643def5e3d9a5404.t: Winning. Every challenge pays by rank: 500 for 1st, down to 100. Podium streaks add a bonus, and the Final Showdown pays double!

643df382c122e859.t: Every case, your phone holds your agency card. Hold it to peek at your secret password, and keep it hidden from your neighbours.

6463b5188cce7f04.t: The conveyor is speeding up. Stay calm, move fast.

647d71359c8aa4cb.t: Pick a topping and tap the tacos that get it. Two tacos with onion means two tacos!

648e8ea7fecf5289.t: Meme of the Night. The night ends with a Meme of the Night showdown, awards and a gallery you can download.

64a1164fc6c2c075.t: Two armies, one front line. Sunrise vs Nightfall. Your troops march on their own and fight whatever they meet. The flag in the middle is the FRONT LINE.. Check your team at the top of your phone.

64d7020575262b58.t: Keep it friendly, darlings. The host can hide any photo.

64ea0104b506e73d.t: A hint, from one detective to another.

650aad8e0cc8d2eb.t: Close! A little more salsa in your heart next time.

6597abf229f7591e.t: The reading. Answers are read out one by one with no names, so nobody knows whose is whose. Once a game you can swap your whole hand.. New hand swaps all your cards (once a game).

662f88617f651d35.t: Watch it! The scoops go in order, bottom to top!

665bcc57049a6187.t: Eyes on the burger! What goes where?

674fccf5b95a4f6c.t: Your move. Hit for another card, Stand to stop. Double doubles your bet for one last card. Split turns a pair into two hands.. Tap Hit, Stand, Double or Split.

68330c8aee0edd6c.t: New case, agents. Check your phones, and keep your card to yourself.

69bd02ca4a1657ea.t: Listen to your head chef. Then roll.

6a5a53a1b145f81d.t: Every suspect files three statements. Two are true. One is a lie. Make it a good one.

6b7e9e486db8593b.t: Perfecto! That plate is a work of art!

6d6737769b3e8f0b.t: Oof! That one’s a money pit!

6d9497ec8efc321b.t: Your turn. Everyone takes turns putting a funny video on the big screen: YouTube, Shorts, TikTok or Instagram Reels. Search, or paste a link, then tap Use it.

6e29335e60fb9367.t: Y’all missed out on that one!

6eba61a01d7f8bc0.t: Be unique. Unique answers score 1. If anyone else wrote the same answer, it scores 0. Think different!

70547f065186b76a.t: Good evening, darlings, and welcome to the Most Likely To awards! I'm Velvet Vance!

70c3a120e4e0ade5.t: Scoring. Points for every scene and every day you survive, and +500 for the rescue. Not everyone makes it: whoever gets furthest wins!

7177c69df0b8191a.t: Beautiful. Like a poem on a plate.

71b325710ad6cbbe.t: The mole got away. We will get them next time.

72379f7d3eefde8f.t: Photo hunt! Find it, frame it, and bring it back to me.

727c4947b70c1518.t: Power-ups. Star pegs and slots give power-ups: Sticky Ball, Mega Ball, Twin Drop, Eraser and Ink Refill.. Got a power-up? Tap it before you lock in your drop.

72f803dba2ecbb02.t: Grab your evidence. The clock is ticking.

7399c6492e346d8f.t: Members of the house, take your seats!

73b1b8260b7b493f.t: One of you has the ticket. Read it out loud, no peeking!

7417dd6670436f55.t: Every round I give you an assignment. Something to find, a colour, a letter, or a face to pull.

74b946400ed5ce70.t: Hear ye! Be the first to empty thy hand, and the crown is thine!

7618fc6dd85dc9d4.t: A premium locker! Fancy stuff, folks!

7626349c5d32b762.t: Type a funny fact! Bonus points for embarrassing!

764ffcdb70b01e06.t: Vote. The TV parades every meme, then everyone votes for the funniest: 100 points a vote. No voting for your own!. Tap the funniest meme to vote.

768495173c2f46ae.t: Everyone else: the manual. Experts get DIFFERENT pages of the field manual. Each module’s rules are split between two experts, so the whole room has to talk.. Expert? Flip through your pages, and ask the defuser what they see.

770a780d47db31d7.t: When every lock is open, read out your clues and point to the culprit. Choose carefully. A wrong accusation costs us a minute.

771b619a1e788cf8.t: Draw the guess. The next player sees only that guess and draws it… and so on around the circle. Things get weird fast!. Draw the words you see, then tap Done .

777112c28021b658.t: Perfetto! Just like my mamma made.

7818a358e2bdad6f.t: The GRAND locker! Double the stuff!

7825711d7a4985de.t: Smash their fortress. Troops that reach the far wall damage its keeps. Knock down every enemy keep to win, or hold the front line deepest in their land when time runs out. Last 90 seconds: FINAL CHARGE!. Your keep’s health is on your phone. It buzzes when it’s hit!

784ca89343edbb9c.t: Draw it. Everyone gets a secret prompt and draws it on their phone.. Draw with your finger, then tap Done . ( New prompt swaps it.)

78faaaa4ff93951d.t: That roll has lost its way.

7978aa968095872c.t: Make it just like the order, sweeties!

7997c67d9b9e75d6.t: Three statements. One lie. And somebody in this room is a very good liar.

79aa938569c93707.t: The royal trade. Finishing order gives titles, President down to Scum. Next deal the Scum must hand the President their best cards!. President? Tap the cards to give back, then tap Give.

79fb5dc574a54d70.t: Shopping Spree. The last round shows three items. Guess the TOTAL: it’s worth double points. Highest score wins!

7a180b877194887f.t: The reveal. The TV replays every book, entry by entry, from the first prompt to the final guess.

7d85abd53982bd5a.t: Scoops up! Here comes a customer!

7ff4bc473cdba06e.t: Pick your teammates. Who shares your password?

80736a7270abdd6f.t: Close-up mystery! Get so close that nobody knows what it is.

813efee3463acf64.t: Eight pieces. Make every one count.
